verdict.rationale: A machine-readable API spec is a fair question for TruffleHog, since it ships a hosted and self-hosted Enterprise platform with a web UI. However, the evidence documents no OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found every common OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The only machine-readable artifacts are markdown docs and a CLI, and neither is an API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
